title: AW-13 seed corpus — the doctrine sources of the graph-backed architecture wiki
design: estate ADR-011 (wicked-estate/docs/adr/ADR-011-architecture-wiki.md); arch-R9 (recon-2026-08/RECON-ARCH-WIKI.md); ingest machinery = wicked-core `rules ingest|fanout|relink|drift` (this crate)

conventions.seed_projection: a committed, frontmattered rule doc under seed/corpus/ derived from an upstream source that is not itself adapter-ingestable; provenance.ref cites the projection, the projection's Sources section + this manifest cite the upstream
conventions.direct_ingest: the upstream doc already parses under the MarkdownAdapter convention and is staged verbatim into the ingest root
conventions.knowledge_scope: wiki:<area> per arch-R5; rationale chunks are stamped by `rules fanout --knowledge-scope`, bulk docs by `knowledge.ingest {scope}`
conventions.ruleset_grouping: frontmatter `domain:` selects the NodeKind::RuleSet parent; membership = native Contains edges (AW-13)

assumptions: TARGET-ARCHITECTURE.md lives at the WORKSPACE root's scratch/ directory, which is not inside any git repo; its owned home is parked decision P-4 (RECON-ARCH-WIKI open question 4). Until it lands in an owned repo, the seed ships a projection (corpus/plane-boundaries.md) and this manifest pins the upstream content digest.

Cross-repo doctrine fans out under `--scope workspace` (AW-6 replicate-to-every-repo): production seeding enumerates EVERY live repo graph as --discovery-db; the scratch proof run uses one indexed repo graph as the stand-in and the runbook says so.

workspace root (NOT a git repo — same P-4 caveat)
